overview: AI Assistant is in the left menu. Its heading is 'AI Assistant'. You can ask about MCL or have it prepare a reviewable checklist draft. It is drafts only: it never saves or activates anything; you review every proposal before it is copied into the form. The page offers shortcuts 'Create a checklist', 'Suggest questions' and 'Explain MCL', with a chat on the left and a 'Complete preview' of the draft on the right.

screenshots.alt: The company AI Assistant page in the MCL web platform
screenshots.description: The MCL web 'AI Assistant' page: a note that it is drafts only and never saves or activates data, shortcut cards Create a checklist, Suggest questions and Explain MCL, a chat area, and a Complete preview panel for the draft.
